title: Freeze evaluation, splits and scenario oracles
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Split/benchmark manifests are hashed before synthesis and stay isolated from generator seed input.
All scenario outcomes are executable under explicit rules and terminate within bounds.
Coverage targets, sample design, metric denominators and release thresholds are preregistered rather than chosen after results.
description: Define observable correctness and leakage boundaries before synthetic expansion can contaminate evaluation.
